units.source_text: 她觉得有些狼狈，俯伏着身子，其娇羞之态，妩媚动人。

en.t: She felt somewhat embarrassed and bent herself low; her shy, modest manner was charming and deeply moving.

units.source_text: 那双玉手像春笋一般圆肥，身材肌肤像水葱一般鲜嫩。

en.t: Her fair hands were round and plump like spring bamboo shoots, and her figure and skin were as fresh and tender as young green onions.

units.source_text: 源氏看了，觉得反而恼人更甚。

en.t: When Genji saw her, he found himself all the more painfully stirred.

units.source_text: 这一天他就稍稍明显地向她求爱。

en.t: That day he made his courtship of her somewhat more open.

units.source_text: 玉鬘心甚痛苦，张皇不知所措，全身战栗不已。

en.t: Tamakazura was deeply distressed, flustered and helpless, and her whole body would not stop trembling.

units.source_text: 源氏也分明看出她的心情，便对她说道：

en.t: Genji clearly perceived her feelings as well, and said to her:
Why do you keep yourself so distant from me?

units.source_text: 我一定巧妙地隐秘，决不会惹人讥议。

en.t: I will certainly conceal it skillfully and will never bring criticism upon us.

units.source_text: 你也该装作若无其事，悄悄地爱我吧。

en.t: You too should act as if nothing is happening and love me quietly in secret.

units.source_text: 我对你的情爱一向甚深，如今又加深了一层，

en.t: My love for you has always been very deep, and now it has grown deeper still,
so that it may truly be called unmatched in all the world.

units.source_text: 与写情书给你的那些人比较之下，

en.t: Compared with those men who write love letters to you,
surely you would not look down on me.

units.source_text: 像我这样一往情深的人，世间实甚难得，所以将你嫁与他人，

en.t: A person as devoted and deeply loving as I am is truly rare in this world, and so, if I were to marry you off to someone else,
I would be very uneasy about it.

units.source_text: 此种父女之爱，真可谓太过分了。

en.t: This sort of love between father and daughter can truly be called excessive.
